data.one_liner: A Dart validation library inspired by Zod with optional code generation support.
data.what_it_does: Luthor provides a fluent API for building schema validators and validating structured data in Dart and Flutter. It yields typed output and structured issues with codes, paths, and messages.
use_when: You want Zod-like schema validation in Dart and Flutter.
You need typed validation output with or without code generation.
You want custom error messages and cross-field validation.
avoid_when: You are looking for an all-in-one Flutter form builder UI widget library.
You are targeting Dart versions older than 3.11.
strengths: Fluent and intuitive API inspired by Zod.
Supports optional code generation for type-safe SchemaKeys and ErrorKeys.
weaknesses: Requires learning a custom validation rule syntax and API.
data.setup_notes: Add luthor to pubspec.yaml. Optionally add build_runner and luthor_generator for code generation features.
